name: Moshimo Youmuin no Oji-san ga Saimin o Oboetara... ~Onna Kyoushi o Midara ni Otosu, Nikuyoku no Houetsu Saimin~
original_name: もしも用務員のおじさんが催眠を覚えたら… ～女教師を淫らに堕とす、肉欲の法悦催眠～
source:
The protagonist, Suguri Suguru, is subjected to power harassment on a daily basis by the school principal, Togasaki Touko. 

Funakoshi Sumiya (self-proclaimed hypnosis counsellor) notices this and scouts Suguri as a hypnosis trainer. The counsellor, Sumiya, says that he would like Suguri's help in seducing the female teachers he has chosen as his targets. As a reward for seducing them, he is told that he can set one of them free, and after much deliberation, Suguru decides to help. 

His main reason for doing so is his desire to get revenge on the school principal who bullies him. He learns simple hypnosis techniques and prepares to seduce women. Once he has learned everything, Suguri finally sets his sights on female teachers...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc040/story.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公须栗须每天都受到校长富崎灯子的权力骚扰。

住宫船越（自称催眠咨询师）注意到了这一点，并发掘杉作为催眠训练师。辅导员Sumiya说，他希望Suguri能帮助他引诱他选择的目标女教师。作为引诱他们的奖励，他被告知他可以释放其中一个，经过深思熟虑，Suguru决定提供帮助。

他这样做的主要原因是想向欺负他的校长报仇。他学习简单的催眠技巧，准备勾引女人。得知一切后，杉终于把目光投向了女教师……

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc040/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
